reviews.author: Jynecci Tillman
reviews.text: was charged $110 labor to replace a single headlight bulb on a 2019 kia forte FE. invoice states bumper was removed, though this vehicle allows bulb replacement from behind without bumper removal. work was completed, but pricing felt excessive for the service performed. yes i felt like i was taken advantage of. I've seen my own headlight replaced and all that was needed was to go under the hood. i was not quoted before they started working on it. $154 for nothing. will not be returning. looks like i was also charged for TWO headlights. i only need one changed. ***reply to response from company*** i understand that shops follow labor guides and flat-rate pay, and that technicians are sometimes paid based on efficiency. my concern was not about the pay structure, but about transparency and communication. i was charged for a bumper removal when this was never clearly explained to me or confirmed as necessary. had i known this upfront, i would have made an informed decision and likely would not have been upset. the one-star review reflects my experience with the service and communication, not an unwillingness to discuss the issue. clear, honest explanations of what work is being done and why would have prevented frustration and disappointment.

reviews.author: Courtney O'Neal
reviews.text: In my opinion, this is the best mechanic shop around & the only place I'll get my vehicles done! Stu & the guys are awesome!

reviews.author: Michael M
reviews.text: Stewart fixed what was wrong with my vehicle for a VERY reasonable price, and they don’t charge extra for credit card transactions! I dont leave reviews much, but this place was a blessing. Had a very honest interaction and Stewart and he let me know what I might have to fix with my car in the future. Thanks to the team at 401 Automotive Services!

reviews.author: David Worrell
reviews.text: These guys are extremely fast, professional and very reasonably priced. The place is very clean and well kept. The staff there is very courteous and knowledgeable. I had a pretty serious issue with my vehicle and these guys had the problem diagnosed repaired with vehicle ready for pick up in less than 2 hours .

reviews.author: Wen
reviews.text: Always receive excellent, fair priced repairs and service on our domestic and foreign vehicles. They’re polite and transparent about their work. Consistently 10 / 10

reviews.author: Joye Allen
reviews.text: The best in Darlington SC. This shop will let you know what’s the problem, how much it will be, and will have you back on the road the same day. Very professional, knowledgeable, and honest. The owner will easy your worries, from the time you drop you drop your vehicle off.. And the prices are affordable .Thanks 401 Automotive Service

reviews.author: Bryan Johnson
reviews.text: Stuart is great! Very knowledgeable, honest and does great work! He's very reasonably priced and won't try to sell you work you don't need, and he will get your car back to you as fast as he can. When you get it back, you can guarantee that the work has been done right! I won't take my vehicles to anyone else. I won't take my Mom's car anywhere else, either. There are a lot of places nowadays that will take advantage of you when it comes to fixing your car. 401 Automotive Services isn't one of those places. I like knowing that if I take my Mom's car there, whatever work was done, was done correctly and she's going to be safe driving it down the road. They haven't been around very long, but Stuart and 401 Automotive Services are the absolute best in the Darlington/Florence area, and it's not even close.

reviews.author: Michelle Larrimore
reviews.text: Love this business! Mr. Stewart is always so friendly & eager to help. He always fixes the problem & never had any issues with repairs that have been made! Will happily use 401 Automotive every time a repair to any vehicle in my fleet is needed!!!

reviews.author: Chris Wilkes
reviews.text: I often perform many repairs on my own vehicles. Simply because the fact I do not trust others to perform on a high-level. I trust Stewart and his coworkers as much as I trust myself. I dropped a vehicle off at 9 o’clock at night via tow truck with a head problem and they had it repaired for a very reasonable price by 9 o’clock the next morning. You will not find better automotive services in this area!!!

reviews.author: Kristen Alexander
reviews.text: I honestly wouldn't give this place not even one star!!! Beware of 401 auto and it's owners Stewart and Marion they will scam you out of your money swearing they scanned the codes and fixed the problems when it's all a crock of bullshit!!! I'm without my 2018 Chevy bc 401 caused problems where there weren't any issues. My car has been in and out of 401 since October 9th 2024 then immediately into another shop to try and correct what should've been corrected by 401. I will never ever take another vehicle to them for any type of repairs. I've lost over $5000 in repairs because of 401 automotives mistakes. I just spent 993.46 at your shop on October 9th your mechanic went into my motor unnecessarily costing me more money than what you've already charged so stop trying to make it sound like you did me a favor when infact you ruined my vehicle. Thanks for nothing!!!

reviews.author: Jessica Williams
reviews.text: I feel like I was completely taken advantage of as a woman. I got a headlight BULB and a turn signal BULB replaced here and I was charged $108. I wasn’t told the cost beforehand. If I would have knew it costed that much I would have waited. I was quoted $60 for a brake pad change from them so I never would have thought a headlight and turn signal would have costed DOUBLE THAT. And I knew it sounded high so I called my dealership to see what they would have charged and they quoted me $75. He’s almost double that. You definitely lost a potential loyal customer and anyone that asks me about this location I will advise them to NEVER go here. You just don’t do business like that. I even called and spoke with him before I left this review to let him know that I felt like I was way overcharged & what the dealership quoted me, and that I wish he would have communicated this with me beforehand but all he did was tell me his labor prices were $105 an hour and apologized.

reviews.author: Marvin Henderson
reviews.text: The name of this place needs to be changed to the pit crew! They replaced lifters on my Tahoe and more in quickest fashion. They called every time they reached a new spot in the line of work and kept my informed properly! This place does not get the credit they deserve! This is hands down the best shop I’ve encountered in a long time! Thanks again guys!

reviews.author: Jon M
reviews.text: I was traveling from out of town and had car issues. I called and Stuart who is the owner couldn’t have been more accommodating. David worked on my vehicle and they got me back on the road in just a few minutes and the price was outstanding. Would highly recommend. If I was local to Darlington this would be my new auto repair place for everything.

reviews.author: Dawn Baker
reviews.text: Ok, let me just say Stu and team are the best. I took my vehicle in because of an issue and found out(Stu informed me) that it was worked on before, but the problem wasn’t fixed. Believe me when I say that when I left the shop I didn’t have that problem anymore. Stu and his team were so thorough and explained everything that was wrong, what they found and what could be done. Don’t hesitate to take your car to 401the work will be done RIGHT!!!!

reviews.author: Stan Lane
reviews.text: I was told the charge for an oil change was $37. No problem I furnished my own oil, oil filter and air filter. When I go to pay its now $69. he charged $32 to put the new air filter in. They didn't check for leaks and didn't check any fluid levels or grease any fittings on the suspension or check the rear end. If they had checked the levels the washer fluids are low and the power steering fluid has a small leak. So HALF the work for the FULL price. They will never get any of my money that type or lack of work. VERY DISPOINTED.

reviews.author: K Smith
reviews.text: Thank you for being open on memorial day. After being stranded on the side of the road for two hours, I was towed here. Needed a new alternator. They had the part and had it replaced in 25 minutes! The longest wait was charging the battery.

reviews.author: Quan Fleming
reviews.text: The owner/manager smh rude, well the first time I visited this shop there were two younger guys very polite and helpful gave me advice about what should be done, they replaced a wheel bearing on my vehicle no appointment on the spot job well done couldn't wait to go back and two weeks later when I did I dealt with the owner, proceeded to tell him the problem I had with my SUV totally different vehicle I have 3 by the way and his vibe was "I don't care" he didn't give any advice about what should be done just stood there and stared at me, I explained to him It was a starter problem and his response was "so what do you want me to do?" Smh I said "well I want it fixed lol", long story short he replaced the alternator which was not the problem waist of money and time. "Not recommended"

reviews.author: Tom Olcott
reviews.text: I’m a New Yorker who was down there for the race, we had trouble with our truck and Stuart who went above and beyond to help my wife and me. He got our truck back up and running so we could make it back home. He even called me a few days later to see how we made it back home. I can’t thank Stuart enough for all the help and hard work he did. I would highly recommend this shop. Only wish Stuart was still turning wrenches back north as I would use him again

reviews.author: Donte Taylor
reviews.text: I have taken my 2010 Chevy Truck to.401 for some major issues; all of which were addressed professionally, and service was completed in a timely manner. I trust 401 with my vehicle completely.

reviews.author: Terry Crosby
reviews.text: Thier name should be, Absolutely Awesome Automotive. The service was great. The work was better than factory, and I was informed of the cause of the problem and what needed to be done before the job was started. They are my number one go to for anything automotive. Thanks for everything Stuart.

reviews.author: Donte Coe
reviews.text: If you don't know to much about cars please don't take your care to Stuart he recommended parts for me total came out over 2,000 dollars took it somewhere else they said every part he recommended was right but he tried to charge different prices for every part when i could have order everything together it was a kit and the total came out to 195$. i will only recommend someone take there car there for small jobs nothing more then a oil change Donte Coe

reviews.author: Angela Watts
reviews.text: Wud definitely recommend 401 automotive for anyone looking for a good job and fast..Mr.Stuart is an awesome mechanic,very friendly and has always been there for me,if it just a simple ?? Or a quick fix...very satisfied with his attitude and eagerness to help..Thank you Mr.S for an outstanding job on my car and for answering any questions I may have.

reviews.author: Robert King
reviews.text: I have been getting my car serviced here for over two years. Each time has been a good experience and handled professionally. They keep my car running smooth!

reviews.author: Dan and Dawn LaMontagne
reviews.text: My husband and I have the highest respect for this place. Stuart(the owner), and employees know their stuff, for sure. Their prices are reasonable to. Thats why their business is gowing.

reviews.author: John Thomas
reviews.text: Amazing place, good price, done within a day, always correctly diagnosed and will take responsibility if they mess up a little. Love this place.

reviews.author: Robert McDonald
reviews.text: Diagnoses the problem quickly without looking for "add-on" charges. Prices are reasonable and work is completed quickly, usually the same day.

reviews.author: sarah saverance
reviews.text: Completely over priced and extremely rude, had to go back not even a month later to have the same thing repaired again.

reviews.author: Bobbie Bellaire
reviews.text: Very friendly, fast service, don't make you feel like you don't know what your talking about because your a girl. Will definitely recommend and return if need any other services

reviews.author: Rodney Hayward
reviews.text: Outstanding place Have visited this place twice. I can say I have been taken care of very quickly. And I can say they know what they're doing.

reviews.author: Henry Eldridge
reviews.text: I HIGHLY REOMMEND 401 AUTOMOTIVE, ATTENTION TO DETAIL AND GREAT MECHANICS. I'M COMPLETELY SATISIFIED WITH THEIR SERVICE.
